mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.employee_id as employeeId, e.real_name as employeeName, e.avatar, a.ATTENDANCE_DATE, a.status FROM attendance a LEFT JOIN employee e ON a.employee_id = e.id
AND a.employee_id = #{employeeId}
AND e.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{employeeName}, '%')
AND (a.ATTENDANCE_DATE >= DATE(#{date,jdbcType=DATE}) AND a.ATTENDANCE_DATE < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{date,jdbcType=DATE}), INTERVAL 1 DAY))
AND a.status = #{status}
AND a.ATTENDANCE_DATE >= DATE(#{startDate,jdbcType=DATE})
AND a.ATTENDANCE_DATE < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY a.ATTENDANCE_DATE DESC, a.employee_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
